State Employee

Employee

In the state's central payroll system, an Employee is any individual who provides service for compensation who is hired, elected or appointed to a position within state government. An employee and an FTE (full-time equivalent) are not the same thing. An employee is a person, while an FTE is equivalent to a certain number of hours worked or authorized to be worked.

Instructions

Enter the complete last name and first name of the employee to display, then click the Display Employee button. This serves as your written request for a specific individual's name, classification and salary under ARSD 55:09:02:01.

ARSD 55:09:02:01. Personnel records. The personnel file and all personnel records pertaining to applications for employment, personnel investigations, performance appraisals, donation or receipt of vested leave, health or retirement benefits, and competitive examination materials are confidential. An employee's name, classification, and salary may be released to a person upon written request. Additional information may be released if the request is accompanied by an authorization signed by the employee. Lists of employees with their home or office locations or other statistical compilations may only be released for legitimate state government purposes.
